In Re: CRAN 1 of 2024 & CRAN 2 of 2024 In CRAN 1 of 2024 Koushik Dandapat @ Kaushik Dandapath @

Kousik Dandapat has preferred an application for bail during the pendency of the appeal while in CRAN 2 of 2024 Bharati Dandapat @ Bharati Dandapath was granted interim bail after the order of conviction was passed by the learned trial court being the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Khatra, Bankura in connection with Sessions Case No.12(09)2015 corresponding to Sessions Trial No.05(02)2016 arising out of Taldangra Police Station Case No.29 of 2011 dated 11.04.2011.

The records of the case reflect that the husband, Koushik Dandapat was convicted and sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for five years and to pay fine of Rs.3,000/- for the commission of offence under Section 306 of the Indian Penal Code and also for a period of one year and fine of Rs.1,000/- with default sentence for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

The applicant/appellant no.2, Bharati Dandapat @ Bharati Dandapath, on the other hand, was sentenced to suffer simple imprisonment for one year and fine of Rs.1,000/- with default sentence for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
She was thereafter granted bail by the learned trial court for a period of 65 days.
Having considered the fact that the applicant/appellant no.2, Bharati Dandapat @ Bharati Dandapath is already on interim bail, her order of bail is hereby confirmed.
However, she would furnish fresh bond before the learned trial court.
